name: context-attachment-manager
description: A local plugin for image-heavy chats in Codex, Claude Code and other AI agents: earlier images become short placeholders instead of going out with every message, the model fetches the original back by its ID (also after compaction), and the prompt cache keeps working.

capability_evidence.agent-runtime: r code and docs, but we have not tested them live yet.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Claude Code, Cline, Codex, Gemini CLI

friction.note_en: Easy. No setup signals found in the README.
friction.note_zh: 较易上手。README 中没有找到安装/配置说明。

analysis.summary_en: An agent normally sends every earlier image again with each message, so a long chat with many images gets slow and can stop going through.
highlights: Nothing is deleted: your original images and chat history stay as they are.
The model fetches what it needs: when it has to look at an earlier image again, it gets the original back by its ID.
The cache keeps working: a placeholder is written once and then stays the same, so the earlier chat is still read from the model's prompt cache.
It can tell images apart: the model notes one line on what each image shows, plus your comments on it.
analysis.summary_zh_native: Agent 每发一条消息，通常会把之前所有的图再发一遍，图一多，对话就越来越慢，最后可能发不出去。这个插件给每张图编号（IMG-001、IMG-002……），之前的图改成发一段简短的占位：
highlights_zh: 凭印象找图：搜“雨夜”或“脸最好”，按记得的特征和评价找回来。
占位符只写一次：图片在它出现的下一轮换成占位符，只有那一轮剩下的内容重新处理一次。
取图不动前面的内容：原图加在当前这一轮的末尾，占位符留在原处。
尽量不打断缓存：占位符只写一次，之后不再变，之前的对话照常从模型服务的缓存（prompt cache）读取。
